Microsoft Reactor Tel Aviv — original Dubnov 7 venue closed c. 2023-24; Reactor program moved to Yigal Alon 98 (inside Microsoft's TLV campus, south edge of corridor). Kept in venue list as it remains the closest purpose-built hack space, but logged here to flag the move

LABS TLV (Azrieli Sarona Tower, floors 58-59) — brand retired; re-acquired by building owner Azrieli Group and rebranded as POINT by Azrieli Sarona (now occupying floors 58-61). Listed under the new POINT name
Rothschild 12 (רוטשילד 12), Rothschild Blvd 12 — permanently closed cafe-bar; removed from consideration (per Secret Tel Aviv).
Cafe Sarona (Paradiso / קפה שרונה), 1 Mordechai Maklef St, Sarona — סגור לצמיתות, permanently closed kosher cafe that advertised private-event space; removed.
Cafe 65, Rothschild Blvd 65 — open but breakfast/brunch-only (closes ~13:00) with no private-event offering; not viable for a full-day hack event, excluded.

Meet In Place official site (meetinplace.com) is currently unreachable — root domain, /rothschild8, /en/tel-aviv and /en/location/rothschild-57 all failed this session; venue is still listed via fetched PartySlate/Secret TLV pages, so it is included with flag=contact using the fetched PartySlate link rather than the dead brand URL.

WeWork no longer operates a Rothschild Blvd location — WeWork's current Tel Aviv portfolio page (fetched) lists only Midtown, London Ministore, 23 Shoken, 10 HaZerem, Sarona and Azrieli Town; the legacy Rothschild 18 building appears closed/rebranded, so it was dropped.
Urban Place has no dedicated /events or /contact-us page (both 404); event inquiries run through the location-page tour form, hence flag=contact.

Hotel Rothschild 22 (Leonardo) meeting/rooftop offering was reviewed but excluded: it's a hotel meeting room (12-person Rooftop Atelier), not a cowork/event product in scope, and well under the 50-person floor.
SOSA (13 Shoken St) shows on older lists but has pivoted/closed its public cowork-event offering; could not verify a live dedicated events page this session, dropped to avoid a dead link.
Landwer Cafe Namal — port branch missing from the chain's current official branch list (fetched); still ghost-listed on 2eat. Treat as closed/relocated: do not book.

Greg Cafe Namal (גרג בנמל) — once the port's flagship event cafe with an upstairs events gallery; absent from the chain's 85-branch summer-2026 directory (fetched gregcafe.co.il/branches). Survives only on stale 2eat pages. Do not book.

Aroma Namal — NOT closed, but moved from Hangar 9 to a new Hangar 28 flagship (July 2025, confirmed via official FB/IG announcement); dropped from this list only because every fetchable URL (aroma.co.il store page, namal.co.il, FB post) 403-blocked verification this session.

Context warnings: Shuk HaNamal / TLV Farmers Market (Hangar 12, incl. Caffe Diemme) is slated for renovation and possible extended closure (Time Out TLV report); Nine Beach port branch has severe recent service reviews — excluded.
Cafe Lev / קפה לב — rest.co.il lists it as a port cafe, but it actually operates at Liebling Haus, Idelson 29 (White City center) — excluded as out-of-neighborhood.

Wix Campus (Yunitsman St 5) — confirmed active and hosts 'At Wix' meetups at Bitan 26, but the 500-seat auditorium and event spaces are internal employee/community tools with no public booking form. Listed as a partner lead, not a bookable venue.
Workport event complex — at Bar-Lev Industrial Park in the Galilee (~30 min from Haifa), not Tel Aviv Port. Out of neighborhood.
Eretz Israel Museum MUZA halls (Rothschild 226 / Nofim 150 / Klatchkin 530) — Ramat Aviv, with a view of the Port but not in it. Out of neighborhood.

avoid_too: Azrieli Sarona Tower event floors — corporate, sponsor-controlled, expensive to book without a Big-Tech host
Microsoft Reactor Dubnov — free but capped ~150 theater / 120 classroom, books out months ahead
AWS Floor28 — invite/partner-gated, not a rentable community venue
HaShalom station area at rush hour — no walkable indie cafes for spillover, everything is mall food-court
neighborhoods.name: Sarona / Derech Menachem Begin corridor (Azrieli Sarona, Dubnov, Ha'arba'a)
neighborhoods.rationale: AI Tinkerers Tel Aviv ran Meetup #1 (AI21 Labs, May 26 2025), Supercharge Your Agents (Aug 25 2025), AI Security (Oct 27 2025), the Big MCP Hackathon (231+ attendees, May 12 2025), and End-of-Year Demo Party (Dec 23 2025) at/around Azrieli Sarona Tower; AWS ran its multi-day Gen AI Loft incl. a Nov 19 2025 hackathon day at Floor 28 of the same tower; Microsoft Reactor (Dubnov 7, Hebrew-language, 13k members) anchors the north end; AI Dev TLV '25 conference and Landmark Tower (Ha'arba'a) cyber/startup talks sit on the same Begin-axis.

avoid_too: Mindspace Rothschild event space — polished but pricey and skews founder/investor, not hacker
monday.com HQ auditorium — only bookable via monday.com's own meetup program, not rentable
Rothschild Blvd cafe seating — tiny, laptop-hostile on weekdays 9-17, not 50-200-capable
Levontin clubs — late-night noise rules, poor daytime wifi/power for a hack day
neighborhoods.name: Rothschild–Levontin / Lev Ha'ir (Rothschild Blvd, Ahad Ha'am, Yitzhak Sadeh edge)
neighborhoods.rationale: Tel Aviv's original startup spine still runs bilingual 50-200-person events: Mindspace Rothschild 45 hosts founder meetups, pitch nights and rooftop panels; Rise (Ahad Ha'am) historically ran near-nightly fintech/dev meetups; monday.com HQ (Yitzhak Sadeh 6) hosts the 4.7k-member monday.com AI engineering meetup plus the Sep 17 2025 'AI as a Strategic Partner' session; Abraham Tel Aviv hostel on Levontin is the recurring home of Startup Valley pitch nights and weekly tech networking mixers; PyCon Israel's CFP workshop ran at Bluevine (Yigal Alon 94) on the corridor's east edge.

avoid_too: Wix campus auditoriums — bookable only through Wix's own At-Wix / hosted-group pipeline, not open rental
Hangar 11 / Reading 3 — big concert halls, corporate-priced, overkill for 50-200
Namal restaurants on weekend/holiday — tourist-priced buyouts, no hack-day table layouts
Ramat HaHayal proper (further east) — office parks, dead after 18:00, no cafe culture
neighborhoods.name: Tel Aviv Port / Namal (Wix campus, Bitan 26, Reading/Hangar 11 events quarter)
neighborhoods.rationale: Wix's Namal campus (Bitan 26) is one of the city's largest recurring meetup hosts — the home-grown 'At Wix' group plus many outside dev communities book Wix event spaces (documented by Gabor Szabo's Israel meetup-venues guide), and the surrounding Port/Hangar 11/Reading 3 complex holds the big tech-conference after-parties and Game Dev TLV-scale gatherings — a genuinely separate northern node from the Sarona corridor with large-floor, event-capable, cafe-adjacent spaces.
